sentences.en: Too much spending on rearmament would place an insupportable burden on the nation'sproductive capacity.

sentences.en: Certainly the Bevanites could claim that rearmament was imposing too great a strain on the economy.

sentences.en: From then on, Halifax stood for rearmament, new military strategies and political unity ahead of the coming war. Sentencedict.com
sentences.vi: Từ đó trở đi, Halifax đứng ra tái vũ trang, đưa ra các chiến lược quân sự mới và thống nhất chính trị trước cuộc chiến sắp tới. Senturedict.com

sentences.en: Rearmament was the dominant issue, at least within the Conservative Party.

sentences.en: In the Labour Party the supporters of rearmament - Dalton and Bevin - were forced to work behind the scenes.

sentences.en: He also wants a "large-scale rearmament" of the Army and Navy beginning in 2011.

sentences.en: So, it tacitly approved Germany rearmament. Moreover, America sent Fuller to Germany as well as advocated Welles Plan.

sentences.en: Follow-through on rearmament, nuclear and otherwise, would work against Russia's economic and strategic interests.
sentences.vi: Tiếp theo về tái vũ trang, vũ khí hạt nhân và các mặt khác, sẽ đi ngược lại các lợi ích kinh tế và chiến lược của Nga.

sentences.en: He opposed the rearmament of Japan after world war ii.
